lines.t: We say we love you, with our wondering eyes
Hands in the air, while our hearts compromise
We nod to your ways, we quote what you said Then walk out the door and follow ourselves
instead Thought we were faithful, thought we were
true But when it cut deep, we chose me over you
I didn't see it, I was asleep in the light
Good hearted people, drifting into the night
How did the bride fall in love with herself?
Trade the groom's fire for a mirror on the shelf
We're singing your name with a Judas kiss
Good hearted hands but a heart that resists
And it breaks my heart, it tears me in two
To see your treasured tree like they do
Good-hearted Judas, smiling through the pain
Loving their own lives more than your name
But you search the hearts, you see through the show
You'll re-find your pride in the fires glowing
Though we're running, though we let go
Yahushua shall not lose one soul
They're kind, they're gentle, generous friends
They give you their shirt, they stay to the end
But as for their lives, for the cross, for the cost
They flinch at the flame, afraid to be lost
I didn't realize good could still run
From laying it all at the feet of the sun
They want your comfort, they want your peace
But not the wound where their idols release
How did the bride paint her face with this world?
Perfumed in vanity, diamonds and pearls
Whispering, Lord, with a Judas kiss
Holding their breath when you ask for all of it
And it breaks my heart, it tears me in two
To see your treasure treat you like they do
Good-hearted Judas, playing their role
Guarding their own life, losing their soul
But you search the hearts, you cut to the core
You'll refine with fire, you'll open the door
And though we're flakeless, though we let go
Yahushua shall not lose one soul
You are my joy, you're my holy ache
You are the wine no world can fake
You are my hope when I come undone
You are my rise and my only one
You are my healer, my every breath
You are the life stronger than death
So take this good heart, break it open wide
Burn every idol, I still hide inside
I don't want comfort more than your face
I don't want safety more than your embrace
Take all my reasons, all my control
Step in the graveyard, awaken my soul
If I must lose me to be with you
Then let me be broken
Let my love be true
Drops there is a hope
In the king of kings, in the bridegroom God
Who still sings over a bride
At the ramp from his head
He'll call her again, she will understand
He won't lose one, not one from his hold
He'll refine in the fire, bring them home like gold
Good-hearted Judas, he still calls you mine
Leading with mercy, rewriting your lines
So I lay my life at your wounded feet
Where grief and glory and longing meet
You are my portion, you are my goal
Yahushua shall not lose one soul
You are my portion, you are my goal
There's hope in the King
Who won't lose one soul
